status.label: Not actionable
status.detail: The repro depends on relocating the Local profile folder and junction-linking it to another drive, which is outside supported PowerToys behavior.

next_action.label: No safe public action
next_action.reason: Only a supported-current-build repro would justify a new investigation.

judgment.rationale: The failure is tied to an unsupported environment change rather than a general Command Palette regression.
evidence: The issue is open and labeled Issue-Bug, Needs-Author-Feedback, Needs-Triage, and Product-Command Palette.
The body shows Command Palette failing to open and includes screenshot links.
The reporter says they copied the Local folder to D: with robocopy and junction-linked it with mkdir /J.
The maintainer said the setup was irregular and that cmdpal from a non-system drive was not expected to work.
The reporter says other PowerToys features still work and reinstalling did not fix Command Palette.
judgment.recommended_action: Do not start a code fix unless someone can reproduce the failure without the Local-folder relocation and junction setup.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current evidence points outside a PowerToys-owned implementation change; no competing fix workflow is justified.
